selection: Common endpoint seconds 4..163; both foreground endpoints; original segment=game; project scene=5 and raw segment=other-scene.

project_scene_evidence.manual_confirmation: User confirms this run played project credits.
project_scene_evidence.mechanism: Creates CreditScreen without assigning mGameScene; the previous award scene (5) remains.
project_scene_evidence.limitation: Raw CSV has no CreditScreen pointer or playback position; credits attribution relies on manual confirmation and source audit.

method: sum(process CPU seconds) * 1000 / sum(draw frames); one-second interval averages, not individual-frame timings.
limitations: One serial pair, not repeated ABBA.
Manual t=3 start does not prove frame-exact playback alignment.
One-second endpoint checks cannot exclude all subsecond interruptions.
